assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.9.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to capture the rhythm during symptomatic periods and assess the burden of arrhythmia for further management.
The CPT code for the Holter monitor is 93226.
The service denied under reason code PR-204.
The claim was denied for the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226.
The denial is based on reason code PR-204, indicating that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
No payment will be issued for this specific procedure.
Please review the attached remittance advice for detailed coding information.
You have the right to appeal this determination.

Failure to submit timely appeals may result in the loss of appeal rights.
This clinical indication supports medical necessity for the Holter study.
